text:
incident-bot: PAGERR 🚨 asia-east1 GPU attach failures observed. Autoscaler showing repeated attach errors -> quotaExceeded. Queue length for inference requests spiked from ~120 -> 3.2k in 10m. Posting to #incidents for on-call handoff.

ops-bot: alert details -> project: rw-infer-prod, pool: asia-east1-gpu-rt, error: "quotaExceeded: acceleratorQuotaExceeded". First fail 2026-03-17T09:12:08Z. See logs: https://console.cloud.google.com/logs/query?project=rw-infer-prod

emma: I'm oncall. Jumping on the bridge now. Can someone paste the exact autoscaler error lines?

mike: paste from autoscaler: ```
2026-03-17T09:13:22Z autoscaler: attach attempt id=abc123 region=asia-east1 status=ERROR details={"code":"quotaExceeded","message":"Requested 8 GPUs; available 0"}
2026-03-17T09:14:45Z autoscaler: backoff start 30s
```

ryan: confirmed traffic spike coincides with a scheduled large-batch job from customer ACME (batch-run #2026-03-17-09). That job requested new instances + GPUs.

ana: customer impact: some hosted customers seeing 429/503s for text-generation endpoints in ap-east/asia-east1; user-facing latency increased ~7-12s. No PII exposure. Severity S2 for now.

emma: immediate mitigations we can run now: 1) reroute new requests away from asia-east1 to fallback region us-west2; 2) enable smaller-model fallback for queued requests; 3) kill or throttle the big ACME batch if they approve.

mike: reroute command ready: ``rictl route set --service inference --region-policy "asia-east1:0.0,us-west2:1.0"``. Want to run? This will move new traffic but queued requests still backed up.

ryan: +1 run the route change. Also open a temporary canary to us-central while us-west2 warms.

emma: executing route change now.

ops-bot: executing: `rictl route set --service inference --region-policy "asia-east1:0.0,us-west2:1.0"` -> success. New request distribution updated.

sophia: running warmup to spin spare smaller instances in us-west2: `rictl pool warm --region us-west2 --gpus 8 --count 6` (warmup should finish ~3m)

ana: contacting ACME support now to pause their batch. @mike can you prepare the kill command if they consent?

mike: kill command (ready): `rictl job cancel --job-id batch-ACME-20260317-09 --force`.

emma: also toggling autoscaler fallback to allow CPU-only instances for lower-priority queues: `autoscaler set --region asia-east1 --allow-cpu-fallback true --priority low`.

ops-bot: autoscaler update accepted. Note: this creates degraded-quality inference but prevents complete stall.

ryan: filing quota escalation with GCP support (requesting immediate quota reset / temporary quota): https://console.cloud.google.com/iam-admin/quotas?project=rw-infer-prod - ticket #GCP-78921 created, severity=high.

sophia: temporary status for customers: impacted endpoints will be routed; some requests may see lower-quality model or longer tail latency. Sending banner to status page now.

ana: status update prepared: "Partial service degradation in Asia (asia-east1). Traffic being rerouted; mitigation in progress. Some customers may see increased latency or fallback models." Posting.

mike: ACME replied: approve cancel of batch. Cancelling now.

ops-bot: `rictl job cancel --job-id batch-ACME-20260317-09 --force` -> job cancelled, freed 48 GPUs in queue.

emma: queue dropping: 3.2k -> 400 in 6m. Latency for routed regions stabilizing. Still monitoring. If queue < 200 and attach errors stop we'll close the pager.

ryan: next actions: 1) follow GCP quota ticket for approvals (may take hours), 2) consider adding warm pools in APAC zones overnight, 3) review scheduling limits to prevent single batch starving the pool.

sophia: documenting customer-impacted list and comms in the incident doc: https://internal.redwood/inventory/incidents/1719805555

emma: thanks all. I'll keep the thread updated. If attach errors persist after ACME cancel and reroute, we'll escalate to infra-eng and exec on-call.

incident-bot: PAGERR resolved? monitoring metrics show attach error rate down from 95% -> 4% in last 5m. Marking as mitigation in progress. Please update runbook checklist.

ryan: closing bridge in 20m if stable. Leaving oncall flag to emma for monitoring window.

sophia: leaving PS-comm note and postmortem runbook items for follow-up: quota increase request, warm pool policy, and tenant isolation for large-batch jobs.

emma: closing note: mitigation succeeded, customer batch cancelled, traffic rerouted, warmups in progress. Will open postmortem and link this thread.
